# Spookwerk

> Spookwerk is an app studio in the Netherlands building privacy-first iOS apps. Apps process data on-device wherever possible and are free downloads with a one-time unlock — no subscriptions, no ads, no tracking.

## Apps

- [Vitadatum](https://spookwerk.app/apps/vitadatum/): export your Apple Health data to CSV, entirely on-device. iPhone. ([Privacy](https://spookwerk.app/apps/vitadatum/privacy/), [Support](https://spookwerk.app/apps/vitadatum/support/))
- [HuurScan](https://spookwerk.app/apps/huurscan/): check the legal maximum rent for a Dutch home using the official WWS points system. iPhone. ([Privacy](https://spookwerk.app/apps/huurscan/privacy/), [Support](https://spookwerk.app/apps/huurscan/support/))

## Blog
